user_email_canonical_check.name: user_email_canonical_check
user_email_canonical_check.value: "app"."user"."email" = lower(btrim("app"."user"."email")) AND "app"."user"."email" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+$' AND length("app"."user"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320

action_intent_subject_check.name: action_intent_subject_check
action_intent_subject_check.value: ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."purpose" = 'magic_login' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."invitation_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."purpose" = 'invitation_accept' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."invitation_id" IS NOT NULL)

action_intent_issued_state_check.name: action_intent_issued_state_check
action_intent_issued_state_check.value: ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" = 'requested' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."token_hash" IS NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."key_version" IS NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."issued_at" IS NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."expires_at" IS NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."stable_message_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" IN ('issued', 'consumed') AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."key_version" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."stable_message_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" IN ('expired', 'superseded', 'cancelled'))

action_intent_consumed_state_check.name: action_intent_consumed_state_check
action_intent_consumed_state_check.value: ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" = 'consumed' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" <> 'consumed' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."consumed_at" IS NULL)

action_intent_superseded_state_check.name: action_intent_superseded_state_check
action_intent_superseded_state_check.value: ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" = 'superseded' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" <> 'superseded' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."superseded_at" IS NULL)

action_intent_cancelled_state_check.name: action_intent_cancelled_state_check
action_intent_cancelled_state_check.value: ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."status" <> 'cancelled' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

action_intent_expiry_check.name: action_intent_expiry_check
action_intent_expiry_check.value: "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."expires_at" IS NULL OR ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."expires_at" > "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."issued_at" AND (("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."purpose" = 'magic_login' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."expires_at" <= "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."requested_at" + interval '10 minutes') OR ("app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."purpose" = 'invitation_accept' AND "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."expires_at" <= "app"."action_link_issuance_intents"."requested_at" + interval '7 days')))

delivery_attempt_failure_check.name: delivery_attempt_failure_check
delivery_attempt_failure_check.value: ("app"."delivery_attempts"."status" IN ('retryable_failure', 'permanent_failure') AND "app"."delivery_attempts"."failure_class" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."delivery_attempts"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."delivery_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('retryable_failure', 'permanent_failure') AND "app"."delivery_attempts"."failure_class" IS NULL AND "app"."delivery_attempts"."failure_code" IS NULL)

delivery_attempt_finished_check.name: delivery_attempt_finished_check
delivery_attempt_finished_check.value: ("app"."delivery_attempts"."status" = 'started' AND "app"."delivery_attempts"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("app"."delivery_attempts"."status" <> 'started' AND "app"."delivery_attempts"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

operation_idempotency_completion_check.name: operation_idempotency_completion_check
operation_idempotency_completion_check.value: ("app"."operation_idempotency"."status" = 'completed' AND "app"."operation_idempotency"."result_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."operation_idempotency"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."operation_idempotency"."status" <> 'completed')

outbox_claim_state_check.name: outbox_claim_state_check
outbox_claim_state_check.value: ("app"."outbox_events"."status" = 'claimed' AND "app"."outbox_events"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."outbox_events"."claimed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."outbox_events"."status" <> 'claimed')

outbox_terminal_state_check.name: outbox_terminal_state_check
outbox_terminal_state_check.value: ("app"."outbox_events"."status" = 'dispatched' AND "app"."outbox_events"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."outbox_events"."pg_boss_job_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."outbox_events"."status" = 'exhausted' AND "app"."outbox_events"."exhausted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."outbox_events"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."outbox_events"."status" IN ('pending', 'claimed'))

invitation_email_canonical_check.name: invitation_email_canonical_check
invitation_email_canonical_check.value: "app"."invitation"."email" = lower(btrim("app"."invitation"."email")) AND "app"."invitation"."email" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+$' AND length("app"."invitation"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320

invitation_resolution_timestamp_check.name: invitation_resolution_timestamp_check
invitation_resolution_timestamp_check.value: ("app"."invitation"."status" = 'accepted' AND "app"."invitation"."acceptedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."invitation"."revokedAt" IS NULL) OR ("app"."invitation"."status" IN ('rejected', 'canceled', 'revoked') AND "app"."invitation"."revokedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."invitation"."acceptedAt" IS NULL) OR ("app"."invitation"."status" IN ('pending', 'expired') AND "app"."invitation"."acceptedAt" IS NULL AND "app"."invitation"."revokedAt" IS NULL)

member_removed_at_check.name: member_removed_at_check
member_removed_at_check.value: ("app"."member"."status" = 'active' AND "app"."member"."removedAt" IS NULL) OR ("app"."member"."status" <> 'active' AND "app"."member"."removedAt" IS NOT NULL)

tombstone_state_timestamp_check.name: tombstone_state_timestamp_check
tombstone_state_timestamp_check.value: ("app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."status" = 'prepared' AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."local_applied_at" IS NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."resolution_sequence" IS NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR ("app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."status" = 'local_applied' AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."local_applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."resolution_sequence" IS NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR ("app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."status" = 'committed' AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."local_applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."resolution_sequence" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR ("app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."local_applied_at" IS NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."resolution_sequence" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."security_tombstone_mutations"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL)

tombstone_closure_reason_check.name: tombstone_closure_reason_check
tombstone_closure_reason_check.value: ("app"."security_tombstone_state"."access_closed" AND "app"."security_tombstone_state"."closure_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "app"."security_tombstone_state"."access_closed" AND "app"."security_tombstone_state"."closure_reason" IS NULL)
